title: Cal's outcome contradicts itself: at the Scout Line I chose 'let him make his own choice and stay' and he confirmed it in his own words ('I'd rather fight for the captain than run from my own debts'), but a separate action elsewhere ('win his debt clear at the ring') immediately completed the same quest thread with 'Go home, it's paid' and Lys reacting as if he were always coming home, with no scene showing him change his mind.
where: The Scout Line (Cal's Reckoning) vs The Muster Ground (win his debt clear at the ring)
